content: Hey love, I was thinking about us all morning. How did your big meeting go?
Hey! It went alright, super busy as always. I wish I had more time to just breathe.
You're doing amazing, seriously. I'm so proud of you. I just wish you didn't have to work so hard all the time.
I actually spent today looking at places for us! And I think I found the perfect apartment. Huge windows, lots of sunlight... I can already picture us there after your long workdays.
Really? That sounds incredible. Where is it?

It's in that neighborhood you loved, near the park. Honestly, it feels like it's meant for us. But there's a catch - the landlord says we need to pay a deposit by tonight or it's going to someone else.
Wait, tonight? That's pretty fast. I don't know if I can pull that together.
I know it's sudden, but I don't want us to lose this chance. You know I'd never put us at risk, I met the landlord myself, he seems totally legit. And I already started the paperwork.
Okay, but how much is the deposit? And how do we send it?
It's $2,000 for the security deposit. The landlord only accepts USDT (TRC-20) because he had issues with checks before. I can give you his wallet address if you're okay to send it.
That's a lot. I've never sent USDT before. Is it safe?
I get it, but really, it's just like sending a bank transfer. I'll walk you through everything step by step. I wouldn't let you do it if I wasn't 100% sure it's safe. This is our future, babe.
Alright, I trust you. Can you send me the wallet address and instructions?
Absolutely! Here's the landlord's wallet: TW6rQ4r9p8zXk3y7j1h5bLzN. Just use your crypto app and send the $2,000 there. Let me know when you've done it, okay?
Okay, I'll try to do it before my next call. Can you stay online in case I mess something up?
Of course! I'm right here for you. Once it's done, I'll forward the confirmation to the landlord and we'll be all set. I can't wait for us to start this next chapter.
Thanks. I'm a little nervous but excited, too. I'll message you when I finish.
You're doing this for us, and it means the world to me. I promise you're not alone in this. We'll celebrate together soon!
